body.name: Explicit graphwise discretization constant
body.construction: Compute \(a_v\) recursively along \(V\) by \(a_v=L_v(1+\sum_{w\in\operatorname{Pa}(v)}a_w)\) for continuous vertices and \(a_v=m_vL_v(1+\sum_{w\in\operatorname{Pa}(v)}a_w)\) for categorical vertices, then set \(C_{\mathrm{sieve}}=L_Q\sum_{v\in V}a_v\).
